text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- The Financial Markets Committee (CMVM) said the state would not have to launch a bid for struggling ship repairer Lisnave as part of its restructuring.
- Banco Mello concluded an issue of perpetual subordinated bonds for 17.5 billion escudos.
- The banking sector has surged on Lisbon bourse, benefiting from huge flows of funds in the privatisation of utility EDP.
- A wave of speculation is pushing up the share price of ship repairer Lisnave close to 400 escudos.
- British Airport Authorities is interested in the planned privatisation of airport company ANA - Aeroportos e Navegacao Aerea, the newspaper learned.
